title: File:Learning Muay Thai with Royal Thai Marines 160213-M-CX588-047.jpg
author: Gunnery Sgt. Ismael Pena
description: Service members from the Royal Thai, Republic of Korea, and U.S. Marines practice Muay Thai techniques with Royal Thai Reconnaissance Marines during Cobra Gold 16 at Sattahip, Thailand, Feb. 11, 2016. CG 16 is a multinational training exercise developed to strengthen security and interoperability between the Kingdom of Thailand, the U.S. and other participating nations.  (Photo by GySgt Ismael Pen
